title: Elixir of Tiefling Vice

sources.title: Burning Hands
markers: | description = Each flammable target is hit with {{DamageText|3d6|Fire}} damage.

summary: Until Long Rest, gain one use each of Thaumaturgy, Hellish Rebuke, Burning Hands and Flame Blade.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain one use each of Thaumaturgy, Hellish Rebuke, Burning Hands and Flame Blade.
fields.Acquisition: Trade tiefling blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Thaumaturgy: Action on yourself. Gain advantage on Intimidation and Performance checks for 10 turns.
fields.Hellish Rebuke: Reaction when attacked. Deal 2d10 Fire, Dexterity save for half.
fields.Burning Hands: Action. Deal 3d6 Fire in an approximately 16 ft cone, Dexterity save for half.
fields.Flame Blade: Bonus Action. Conjure a scimitar for 10 turns that deals 3d6 Fire and sheds light.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
